node.title: DSP8 unit-product trace normal form
node.statement: Every decorated DSP8 primitive cubic shift pair has a unique product-one normalization. If q^3=RS and the six roots are divided by q, then q=rs, ruv=sxy=1, the two triples have common trace sigma, and the retained target is t=1+rs(r+s-sigma). Conversely these normalized data reconstruct the decorated pair with no free H-scale. Thus the exact residual is a common-trace pair of subgroup-split quadratics coupled to one quotient line; generic degree-three SP all-pairs counting is too coarse and supplies no DSP8 bound.
